reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to a small business owner in Bareni's calm, practical voice. It respects the required no-CTA rule and reinforces human approval boundaries.
reasons.clarity: The argument is clear, logically structured, and easy to follow on a first read, explaining why simple stopping rules fail without proper exception mapping.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, one-page exception-mapping exercise and a clear audit next step appropriate for an owner-operator considering workflow automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately references the accounts-payable demo, explicitly noting synthetic data, manual simulation, and mandatory human controls without overclaiming.
